title: Humming three-phase power boxes feeding underground

tellings.quote: he heard a humming. Mhm. And he kicks a bush aside, and there's this gigantic three-phase power power box with a cable definitely going into the ground.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, talking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025, tells of a visit to Bradshaw Ranch, a piece of land near Sedona, Arizona. He says a man called Paul heard a humming, kicked a bush aside, and found a huge three-phase power box, the heavy-duty kind of electrical supply used for big machinery, with a cable running straight into the ground. Coulthart tells it as a sign that something is being powered underground there, which, if true, would point to a hidden facility under the ranch.
